title: Illustration and typesetting have no documented agent procedure
description: Reporting has docs/story-reporting.md. The illustration and typesetting stages have no equivalent found in this session's reading, and neither is automated, so a reporting agent guiding a Story through to publication has no process to follow. Write down what each stage produces and who does it, then decide what to automate. Found on the Machines on Machines non-interference Story; revisit when it reaches those stages.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Update 2026-11-03: the context pack now reports the procedure, and marks fact_check, illustration and typesetting as 'not built'. So this is a missing feature as well as missing documentation.
